entries.content:
Sharon Prosser

VP, SMB and Scaled at Google Cloud

Today, we announced the new Gemini agent, your single, universal agent for work. For small and midsize businesses, with lean teams and margins, Gemini will be a critical tool for you to operate efficiently, deliver excellent customer experiences, and grow.

Millions of small and midsize businesses, or SMBs, already trust Google AI across multiple services, like Gemini Enterprise, Google Ads, and Google Workspace. And they are scaling fast: Their usage of Google Cloud’s AI tools increased more than fivefold year over year.

Now, SMBs can benefit from all of the agentic capabilities of Gemini.

The agentic era for SMBs has arrived

Gemini functions as a personal assistant and team member, connects to the systems and data you already use, operates across the interfaces you’re already familiar with, and offers the model choice, security, and cost controls you expect from Google Cloud.

It answers your questions, handles your knowledge work, creates your images and media, and even writes and runs code, all from a single prompt box. You delegate an outcome and come back to finished work. Gemini can act as a flexible team member, playing a specific role such as a project manager, bookkeeper, inventory manager, or marketing consultant.

And, Gemini is architected to be helpful out of the box, with benefits including:

  • Connects to popular SMB tools: Gemini connects to the systems you regularly use, like Asana, Box, Clay, Docusign, Dropbox, GitHub, LegalZoom, Notion, Salesforce, Shopify, Slack, Wix, and more. It utilizes context from these tools, your business data, and work history, and gets smarter and more helpful the more you use it. 

  • Provides model choice: Gemini is the agent, and the model underneath it is a separate choice. It runs each job on the model that fits best—orchestrating across our Gemini family of models and Claude models today, and other leading private and open models in the future. Matching the model to the work raises accuracy on the difficult jobs and lowers cost on the simple ones. And the leading model changes every few months, so keeping that choice open means that even if you switch models, your context, your skills, and your data stay put.

  • Accessible everywhere you work: Gemini works across the surfaces that you use every day, including on the web, Android and iOS mobile devices, Mac and Windows desktops, and applications like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Slack. Because it runs in the cloud, it keeps working even when you step away from your devices.

  • Keeps costs under control: We’ve also implemented leading cost controls into Gemini, to ensure you and your employees can confidently put Gemini to work. This includes multi-model orchestration to choose the right model for the job, smart routing that automatically triages workloads so each one runs on the model that delivers maximum performance at the lowest possible cost, and real-time project-level spend caps in the Cloud Billing Console.

Gemini is in early access with SMB customers today and will be available to all customers soon.

How SMBs are driving results with Google Cloud AI today

Globally, SMBs are already using Gemini Enterprise to drive their businesses forward, here are a few examples:

  • Aerotech, a U.S. industrial automation company, leverages Gemini Enterprise to scale its internal AI problem-solving platform across its workforce, reducing troubleshooting times to increase production capacity.

  • Angelus, a Brazilian dental and healthcare manufacturing company, uses Gemini Enterprise to streamline project management across its research and development department. This enables its teams to automatically pull technical project data into pre-approved templates aligned with the company’s brand identity and regulatory requirements.

  • EdSpan Global, an international education platform, uses Gemini Enterprise to automate the standardization of thousands of digital learning objects, reducing time spent on repetitive editing to accelerate course launches.

  • Eficode, a software development and DevOps firm in Finland, is using Gemini Enterprise to create a multi-platform support engine that quickly indexes complex internal wikis, so employees can provide customers with faster technical support.

  • KLog.co, a Chilean logistics technology company digitizing freight forwarding across Latin America, uses Gemini Enterprise to automate cargo tracking and shipping paperwork, cutting manual data entry errors by more than 90% and increasing document processing capacity tenfold.

  • Koufu, one of Singapore's largest food and beverage companies, is using Gemini Enterprise to automate sales reporting and data analysis. This reduces spreadsheet bottlenecks so shop managers can focus on front-of-house service quality.

  • La Maison du Whisky (whisky.fr), a specialized spirits and beverages retailer in France and internationally, chose Gemini Enterprise to create a 'Digital Sommelier' that transforms technical product data into high-end storytelling and marketing copy in seconds.

  • NEEOH, a leading Brazilian out-of-home advertising communication platform, uses Gemini Enterprise to standardize secure AI usage across its organization, enabling teams to generate campaign copy and build pitch proposals faster while keeping corporate client data secure.

  • Quadrant Health Group, a U.S.-based healthcare and clinical operations provider, uses Gemini Enterprise to unify its fragmented technology systems, automate repetitive back-office tasks, and empower clinicians with secure AI tools that safeguard patient data.

  • Salt Productions and Pinch Creative, U.S.-based event production and creative partner agencies, are using Gemini Enterprise to turn fragmented files into a searchable, single source of truth, reducing administrative work and presentation bottlenecks so staff can focus on event production and design.

  • Sep 2, a digital security provider, uses Gemini Enterprise to deploy autonomous AI agents for 24/7 threat monitoring. It can accelerate incident detection and neutralize security threats.

  • Stratagem, a technology consulting company based in the U.S., uses Gemini Enterprise to automate administrative workflows and develop retail customer service agents, freeing consultants to spend more time with clients and accelerate service delivery.

  • Sunhouse, a strategic brand design agency, uses Gemini Enterprise to easily find archived design work stored on Google Drive, enabling its teams to spend less time hunting for files and more time growing its business with global brands.

Get trained on Google Cloud AI

To help SMB teams get the most out of AI, we’ve created easy, no-cost learning programs that you can use through our Google Skills platform. To get started today, there are two ways to engage on the platform for free: 

  • Claim 35 no-cost credits to access hands-on labs and earn skill badges across all levels

  • Sign your team up for Google Skills for Organizations

Today, Google Skills offers more than 3,000 courses, labs, and credentials to help you build practical skills with Google AI and products like Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise, earn skill badges, and achieve valuable certifications on Google Cloud. Courses on the new Gemini agent will be available soon; in the meantime, you can get started with recommended courses such as:

  • Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud: For SMBs looking to move past simple tools and actually start scaling their broader operations on Google Cloud, this course provides a great entry point for business leaders looking to modernize their infrastructure and security posturing. 

  • Google Workspace with Gemini: For SMBs looking to quickly boost everyday efficiency, this course serves as an essential, highly practical guide to seamlessly integrating AI into daily business operations, from drafting emails to automating simple workflows directly inside Gmail, Docs, and Drive. 

  • SMB Learning Path: For SMBs looking for practical ways to scale their business operations, this catalog of courses focuses on combining introductory gen AI technical foundations with Gemini-led automation and the GEAR framework for custom agent development.

Work with a partner

Our partner ecosystem plays an important role in helping businesses implement Google Cloud AI, including Gemini.

Today, many partners offer certified experts on Google Cloud AI to SMBs, and can help with everything from identifying use cases for AI, prototyping, building custom agents, and more.

Visit our Google Cloud Partner Network today to get started with a partner.

entries.content:
Sandeep Khanna

Managing Director, Google Cloud U.K. & Ireland

In recent decades, Ireland has grown into a vibrant hub for global technology. As modernization accelerates, Irish organizations — spanning government agencies, established enterprise brands, and growing startups in AI and other areas — are all advancing their technical foundations. Today, leaders across the country are injecting agentic AI into every layer of their business and operational workflows.

We are seeing organizations move from early prototypes to production-ready deployments using Gemini Enterprise. This progress supports Ireland's competitive position within the European market. According to a recent Implement Consulting Group report assessing Google’s local contribution, public and private leaders estimate between 40 billion to 45 billion euros of economic potential in global AI markets.

This ambition aligns with broader government initiatives. Since assuming the presidency of the Council of the European Union for the second half of 2026, Ireland has steered higher-level technology and policy discussions, outlining a National Digital and AI Strategy to improve productivity and innovation across sectors.

To support this strategy, we are focused on making these capabilities more accessible. Our local teams are collaborating with industry leaders to implement Gemini Enterprise which offers capabilities that range from conversational AI agents and natural language data analysis, to optimizing operations with agentic ecosystems.

The economic impact is already taking shape. In 2025 alone, Google operations — including our AI and cloud services — added an estimated 10 billion euros to the Irish gross domestic product. And this momentum is shared: Organizations across Ireland are using Google Cloud to modernize infrastructure and put AI to work.

Here are several ways Irish organizations are modernizing with Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise:

Ryanair supports millions of passengers through AI-backed operations

Ryanair, Europe’s largest airline, is modernizing its collaborative operations and infrastructure by deploying Gemini Enterprise and Google Workspace for some 35,000 employees. Flight crews, operations planners, and corporate staff will benefit from streamlined decision-making, optimized crew logistics, and enhanced corporate productivity. At the same time, a dual-cloud strategy strengthens infrastructure resilience as the airline targets growth to 300 million passengers by 2034. 

Smyths Toys rethinks the customer experience with agentic support

As one the world’s largest specialty toy retailers, Smyths Toys is reshaping its customer support with Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise. By introducing an AI agent named Codie, the retailer has resolved more than 60% of its web inquiries and reduced holiday email backlogs. Customer care teams that previously handled up to 1,000 peak-season emails a day can now focus on the roughly 50 cases that need more complex judgment.

The Irish Revenue Commissioners: Advancing public sector data

Public sector agencies are also making strides in Ireland. The Irish Revenue Commissioners — responsible for taxes, customs, and keeping Ireland’s economy running smoothly — is working with Google Cloud to migrate from legacy on-premise systems to a unified AI-lakehouse architecture designed to break down data silos and establish a single source of truth. Strict data sovereignty controls safeguard taxpayer information while Gemini Enterprise powers agentic data analysis, helping Revenue deliver secure, responsive public services.

Virgin Media Ireland: Accelerating workflows

Supported by Liberty Global's partnership with Google Cloud, Virgin Media Ireland is moving AI from exploration to production. Through modern infrastructure and automation, the team now deploys workloads three times faster, is in the process of rolling out multiple AI agents, and is launching new customer services designed to drive business growth.

Irish startups scaling with enterprise tools

While established enterprises are modernizing legacy systems, Irish startups are building on modern technology from day one. Backed by a strong local tech ecosystem, these agile teams are creating services that compete on an international stage.

Hexis: Scaling personalized sports nutrition

Hexis builds technology solutions that help athletes refine their performance and recovery. By storing and processing that real-time biometric and behavioral data in Google Cloud, Hexis uses Gemini Enterprise to power natural language conversations that explain fueling adjustments to users throughout the day. Today, the platform supports 40% of the Tour de France peloton and half of Premier League clubs during the 2026–2027 season.

Kitman Labs: Unifying performance analytics

Founded in Dublin in 2012, Kitman Labs provides sports science and performance intelligence to more than 4,000 sporting organizations across 26 countries. By combining its intelligence platform with advanced analytics and Gemini Enterprise, Kitman Labs helps teams make data-informed decisions that support athlete health, lower injury risk, and extend player career longevity. 

Spryt: Automating healthcare coordination

Spryt streamlines healthcare coordination across the U.K. and U.S., using AI built on Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise to optimize patients’ experiences, reduce missed appointments, and cut administrative burden. The company collaborates with the NHS, operates in more than 70 US clinics, and has analyzed 224 million appointment records as part of a multiyear initiative with Mayo Clinic.

IMPT: Automating carbon offsetting

By connecting AI, blockchain, and Google Cloud, IMPT embeds verified carbon offsetting into everyday hotel bookings and online purchases. Following a 15-week migration to Google Cloud, IMPT supports 8 million listings across 195 countries. With Gemini Enterprise, the company’s lean team handles about 400 daily customer chats with a six-second median response time, allowing staff to focus on growing its business rather than managing systems.
